name: cli-rescue-cc
description: CLI rescue plugins for delegating work to external coding agents — Qwen Code and Gemini CLI

plugins.name: qwen
plugins.description: Delegate substantial coding or investigation tasks to Qwen Code (free tier, 1000 req/day via OAuth). Uses Kimi 2.5.

plugins.name: gemini
plugins.description: Delegate substantial coding or investigation tasks to Gemini CLI (Vesta). Senior engineering partner with persistent identity.
